ThinkByte: Harsha Thota, Mahesh Patil, Vigarna Ramesh
Key Takeaways
Vigarna Ramesh is assigned to create new creatives for Ira, analyze competitor ads, and update paid ads trackers.
Decision to discontinue the lookalike audience ad set due to rising costs and shift budget from 3-4% to 1-2% targeting for better ad spend efficiency.
Paused the core audience campaign due to high cost per lead and adjusted budget and creatives in another due to low click-through rates.
Harsha Thota emphasized the need for a centralized tracking sheet to monitor campaign performance accurately.
Future steps include consolidating campaign data, prioritizing campaign strategies, and organizing travel plans for Bangalore to prepare for next month's activities.

Prioritize documenting the analysis for today.
Consolidate campaign information into a centralized sheet.
